forms.source: Let your sheep run over your net and it will then be a fortunate one.
forms.target: 让羊从渔网上跑过去，这张网就会变得幸运。

somekind of reward
What sort of reward is that?
Now how about my reward?
forms.target: 我的报酬现在怎么样了？

forms.source: Here comes that reward of yours.

After the bear is brought down its skull eventually needs to be placed to hang in a big lone pine-tree. That completes the hunting and burial ceremony and assures proper circulation of the bear spirit.
forms.target: 猎倒熊后，最终要把熊头骨挂在一棵高大、独立的松树上。这样才算完成狩猎和葬礼，确保熊的灵魂顺利轮回。

forms.source: All-round way to sacrifice something in order to please or thank the spirits and otherworldly beings in various occasions.
forms.target: 在各种场合献上祭品，以取悦或感谢精灵和异界生灵的通用办法。

forms.source: Baiting a fox-trap at your hunting grounds should be done just around sunset.
forms.target: 在猎场给捕狐陷阱放置诱饵，应当选在日落前后。

forms.source: Be it birds or hares you are after, the loop snares you are about to use are made favorable by leaving them in an ant nest for three nights, and only then picked up and set for a catch.
forms.target: 无论捕鸟还是捕野兔，都要先把准备用的套索陷阱放进蚁巢，留上三夜，再取出来设陷捕猎，这样陷阱才会灵验。

forms.source: Bear hunter's mittens shouldn't be made of whatever material. It is the dog fur mittens you should wear in order to have your weapons to be effective and cut the bear good.
forms.target: 猎熊人的手套不能随便选材料。应当戴狗毛皮手套，这样武器才能发挥威力，重创熊。

forms.source: Bear is a great hunter who always finds its prey, and hunters who carry bear teeth with them can come across hares and game birds as they please.
forms.target: 熊是总能找到猎物的好猎手。猎人随身携带熊牙，就能如愿遇见野兔和猎鸟。

forms.source: Bird thief will come confess if you take three feathers that have remained from the stolen bird and throw them into heated sauna stove after the fire has burnt out. You can also throw the feathers into remains of burnt-out fire which was made on base rock.
forms.target: 取三根被偷走的鸟留下的羽毛，等桑拿炉的火熄灭后，扔进仍然滚烫的炉子里，偷鸟贼就会前来认罪。也可以把羽毛扔进岩床上燃尽的火堆余烬中。

forms.source: Cut twigs from a living spruce tree and set them burning on the most fresh tracks of the missing animal you can find.
forms.target: 从活着的云杉上折取枝条，放在你能找到的、失踪动物最新鲜的足迹上点燃。

forms.source: Forest maids are attracted to come at nighttime campfires in remote forests of spruce and moss by lighting the fire with seven spruce twigs in there along with good pile of other firewood. Sleep on the moss by such fire and they may appear.
forms.target: 在偏远的云杉和苔藓森林里燃起夜间营火，加入七根云杉枝和足够的其他柴火，就能吸引森林少女。睡在这样的火堆旁、躺在苔藓上，她们也许就会出现。

forms.source: Have a capercaillie feather with you when chasing a lynx. The feather is then put on lynx tracks from where it first fled, on its very first escaping tracks. This will burden the lynx, making it more quickly fatigued.
forms.target: 追赶猞猁时，带上一根松鸡羽毛。把羽毛放在猞猁最初逃跑时留下的足迹上。这会拖累它，让它更快疲倦。

forms.source: I can't speak of it beforehand, but you get a reward of some sort if you help me out.
forms.target: 我现在不能预先说出来，不过你帮了我，就会得到某种报酬。

forms.source: Incantation to greet earth dwellers and underground creatures upon sleeping on the ground at unfamiliar terrain. Performed to assure good night sleep and to avoid being harmed by the possibly angered underground folk.
forms.target: 在陌生地方露宿、睡在地上时，用来向大地居民和地下生灵致意的咒语。施咒能确保安眠，也能避免受到可能被激怒的地下之民伤害。

forms.source: Loop snares for hares shouldn't be set barehanded but you should always wear mittens, and preferably woollen mittens.
forms.target: 设置捕野兔的套索陷阱时，不应赤手操作，要始终戴着手套，最好是羊毛手套。

forms.source: The aspen tree for a punt should be felled when it's raining. Carving a punt out of such a log makes it good and fortunate one.
forms.target: 制作平底小舟的白杨树，应当在下雨时砍倒。用这样的原木凿出的平底小舟会既好用又幸运。

forms.source: The forest can be persuaded to not to hide its thingies when going hunting. It is done by carrying a bread with you which is dropped and left at a spruce on a hill or cliff, and then this specific incantation is cast.
forms.target: 出猎时，可以劝说森林不要藏起它的生灵。随身带一块面包，把它放在山丘或峭壁上的一棵云杉旁，然后念诵这道特定的咒语。

forms.source: The spirit of the forest can be met and addressed by sacrificing silver at an ant nest. You do it alone at night, and then wait for the spirit to arrive. Do not fear and he may speak and show himself to you before dawn.
forms.target: 在蚁巢献上白银，就能见到森林之灵并与之交谈。夜间独自前去献祭，然后等待精灵到来。不要害怕，他可能会在黎明前现身，对你说话。

forms.source: The very first fish of the spring that you catch with a fishing rod in open water season should be thrown back into the water to please the spirit of the water and assure your future fishing luck.
forms.target: 春季水面解冻后，第一次用鱼竿钓到的鱼，应当放回水中，以取悦水之灵，确保今后的捕鱼好运。

forms.source: To get to see spirits of the water you should go stand naked on a rock in the water at night. It must be a single rock or skerry, completely surrounded by water, and the water folk may gather around it at midnight.
forms.target: 要见到水中的精灵，就得在夜里赤身站到水中的岩石上。那必须是一块完全被水包围的孤石或礁岩，水族可能会在午夜聚集到那里。

forms.source: To make a fox trap favourable leave it laying at doorstep of a building where womenfolk will get to walk over it.
forms.target: 要让捕狐陷阱灵验，就把它放在房屋门口，让女人们从上面跨过去。

forms.source: Turn around and kick a tree with your heel and the squirrel will then stay still in there, even if it would have been jumping around a lot earlier.
forms.target: 转身用脚后跟踢一下树，树上的松鼠就会静止不动，哪怕它之前还在四处乱跳。

forms.source: When deadfall trap is made for a bear you should then set the meat bait there completely naked. Then the bear gets in there nicely.
forms.target: 为熊做好落石陷阱后，要完全赤身地去放置肉饵，这样熊就会乖乖进到陷阱里。

forms.source: When first fish of the spring are caught out at a lake in open water season, make a fish soup or boil them right after returning on shore. When it's cooked, go away from the pot so that the spirit of the water can have the first taste.
forms.target: 春季湖面解冻后，第一次在湖上捕到鱼，回到岸边就要立即煮鱼或做鱼汤。煮好后离开锅边，让水之灵先尝第一口。

forms.source: When going rod fishing you should first throw the fishing rod into the water, and then you have a good fishing luck.
forms.target: 出门垂钓时，应当先把鱼竿扔进水里，这样就会有好的钓鱼运气。

forms.source: You get a good catch if you step in the punt backwards and launch it in the water backwards.
forms.target: 倒退着踏进平底小舟，再倒退着把它推入水中，就能获得好渔获。
